target.role: Senior Manager, Executive Portfolio & Financial Management

summary: Senior Manager, Executive Portfolio & Financial Management profile: ~7 years turning complex financial and portfolio data into executive-ready narratives. Holds delegated sign-off authority at Moody's Analytics over analytics delivered to institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement, and serves as the direct escalation contact for clients' Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders when a number needs explaining. Consulting foundation at EY and Ortec Finance coordinating finance, IT, actuarial, and program teams to strict milestone deadlines, including investment-committee presentations at pension-fund clients. CFA charterholder, dual MSc, advanced Excel and Python.
core_skills: Translating Complex Data into Actionable Insights

sections.heading: Executive Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement
bullets: Prepared recurring and ad-hoc analytical summaries for senior stakeholders on rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities, translating quantitative output into investment-committee-ready narratives.
Served as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing directly with clients' Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders on findings, impact, and remediation plans.

sections.heading: Portfolio Performance & Financial Analytics
bullets: Held delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and portfolio analytics delivered to multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement, ~$50bn+ cumulative across the book of work.
Reviewed aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics feeding downstream risk reporting and capital processes.
Led design and delivery of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios across T+1 to multi-year planning horizons.

sections.heading: Operational Efficiency & Delivery Productivity
bullets: Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and documentation, reducing development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable, auditable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging and validation controls.

sections.heading: Quality Assurance & Precision Standards
bullets: Member of the model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and performance assessment of client-delivered analytics.
Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe DB (risk & ALM) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management) platforms.

Acted as technical liaison between client investment teams and product owners, scoping business requirements into development requests and validating outputs post-deployment across all assigned accounts.

roles.title: Senior Consultant, IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Coordinated across actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management teams on milestone delivery and implementation materials for IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation programs.
Advised actuarial, IT, finance, and program-management functions of Canadian and international insurance clients on adoption of IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 standards.
Contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes for financial institutions.
Developed IFRS 17 advisory product offerings and go-to-market collateral for the practice.
Presented study findings and allocation recommendations on-site to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients.

Delivered long-horizon studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors, analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and balance-sheet exposures over multi-year planning horizons.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition and attribution to test the robustness of allocation recommendations.
Advised clients on Strategic Asset Allocation and Tactical Asset Allocation trade-offs through stress testing and sensitivity analysis.
Led onboarding and the study for a three-plan university pension merger on a team of three, developing and validating the model capturing all funding-policy dynamics.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
